title: Temporal AI Presence Profile v1.0
description: Temporal AI Presence is sustained bounded AI participation across time. This standalone profile defines the TAP category, preserves its boundary from c-class systems, specifies ten mandatory tests, and provides a conservative public-safe evidence projection. TAP-T03 remains partial at the deployment-external boundary. The package claims neither TAP-C nor a full M4 pass.
notes: Zenodo manages version DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22070960 and Concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22070959. The version DOI identifies v1.0; the Concept DOI identifies all versions. Registration remains pending publication. The automatic versioning relation is not duplicated as a Related Work.
